BiblicalUsage: Ahuzam is named once, as a son of Naarah in the genealogy of Judah, one of four brothers in a single verse with no story following any of them.
TheologicalSignificance: Beyond his name the Bible says nothing, and I will leave it there. The Chronicler kept the brothers together, and the tribe kept its families.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
